name: NewsletterBot by Contentdrips
tagline: Turns a newsletter link into branded social graphics and carousels.
description: Paste in the link to a newsletter issue and it pulls out the parts worth promoting, which you approve before anything is designed. Those highlights become social graphics and carousel slides through a branded template, either yours or one of Contentdrips' own. Output arrives sized for posting, not rebuilding.
author: im_usamakhalid
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
